summary: STEP 4 broken-link + forms audit across web (/app/frontend) and mobile (/app/mobile). Verified all six previously-broken web link targets now resolve to real routes in App.js. Rendered 3 of the 6 unauthenticated targets via Playwright and they returned real pages (title + long body, no NotFound copy): /services (200 'Support at Home service explainers...'), /ai-tools/provider-price-checker/how-it-works (200 'How the aged-care price fairness check works | Wayly'), /legal/ai-disclaimer (200 'AI Accuracy Disclaimer · Wayly'). The remaining three targets are behind RequireAuth (/app/documents, /app/scenarios, /app/participants/{id}/cases, /app/participants/{id}/timeline) and were verified statically against App.js route table (lines 456, 474, 476, 478). Full-nav web crawl of all static Link `to` targets (145 unique) plus all dynamic template-literal targets — every static target maps to a defined route or the /admin/* catch-all handler. Mobile router.push / router.replace crawl (60+ unique targets) — every target maps to an expo-router file under /app/mobile/app. Forms audit: web /login has native HTML5 required-field validation (captured 'Please fill out this field.' on empty submit). Mobile forms are correctly validated in code: pacing AdHocForm (service + duration + rate), pacing ScheduleForm (service + duration + rate), pacing ReconcileForm (>=1 valid CSV line), Budget Scenarios save (Save disabled when !dirty AND requires label). Copy audit: no user-visible '$$', no em-dashes and no en-dashes on the six changed files, EXCEPT three em-dashes (U+2014) in JSX COMMENTS in /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/InvoiceCheckerTool.jsx lines 666, 768, 775 (never rendered to user). SwitchSettlement.jsx line 25 shows literal '$$' in source but this is a JS template-literal ('$' + '${amt}') that renders as '$1,234.00' — safe. NOTE: interactive login via the web preview and via direct /api/auth/login POST both time out (proxy returned 502 after 60s during this run) so the three authenticated web routes could not be rendered end-to-end; treated this as a preview-env auth flake, not a routing regression, given the static route table proves the targets exist and iteration_254 already exercised /login on the same fork.

issues: Three em-dashes (U+2014) in JSX code comments on lines 666, 768, 775. Not user-visible but violates the 'no em/en dashes' repo-wide copy rule. Suggest replacing with ASCII '-' or removing the dash phrase from the comments.
